title: Sleepy re-picks the same ticket every iteration after queueing it
source_context: JustFacts sleepy run 2026-07-06, iters 1-11 alle JF-007
description: A queued iteration leaves the ticket status=todo, and pick_next_ticket only excludes no-op tickets, so the supervisor re-selects the same ticket indefinitely. Observed: 11 duplicate sleepy/JF-007-N branches, 620k tokens of redundant work in one run. Hotfixed 2026-07-06: exclude statuses no-op, queued and denied from re-selection within a run. Better structural fix: set the ticket to in_review in the ticket system when its branch is queued, and revert on discard.
proposed_changes: Hotfix toegepast; overweeg ticketstatus in_review bij queue + regressietest

triage.evidence: sleepy.py:685-695 sets status_label="queued" and calls append_queue() without any ticket-status update; cmd_apply (825-847) merges and only calls _mark_queue_processed; cmd_discard (850-864) deletes the branch, no status revert; cmd_start re-inits budget with "iterations": [] (527-534), so the exclusion set at lines 588-592 is empty at the start of every new run and a still-todo queued ticket is re-picked cross-run. No occurrence of in_review anywhere in sleepy.py.
triage.note: The within-run hotfix (exclude no-op/queued/denied/failed from re-selection) is in place and was extended by b680ed9, but the proposal's actual ask — the structural fix of setting ticket status to in_review when a branch is queued and reverting on discard — is not implemented. Because the budget file (source of the exclusion set) is re-initialized on every sleepy start, exclusion is per-run only: a queued-but-unreviewed ticket is still status=todo the next night and gets re-picked, producing one duplicate branch and one wasted delegation per ticket per subsequent run. Moderate residual impact (acute loop gone), M-sized multi-spot change within sleepy.py (queue point, apply, discard) plus a regression test. Not prometheus.py, so delegatable.
